name: compdf-add-watermark-remover-watermark
tagline_zh: 给PDF加品牌水印或抹掉草稿标记，一页页来太慢？这个Skill能批量处理，连图片水印也能精准清除。
tagline_en: Add or strip PDF watermarks in bulk—text and image—so last-minute delivery prep takes seconds, not hours.
desc_en: Add or remove text and image watermarks in PDFs with ComPDF. Use for PDF branding, draft review marks, document control, watermark cleanup, and final-delivery preparation.
why_zh: 同类工具只删文本水印，它连图片水印都能识别清除，且批量操作不糊版，机制上直接省掉逐页手动。
why_en: Unlike others, it removes image watermarks too, and batch processing keeps layout intact—no page-by-page manual work.
